title: "Support"

## Donate

**Your financial contribution is what makes this possible.**

To date, we are 100% crowdfunded, and we rely on YOU and generous people like you to
make this project work. We very much appreciate the help because we are a small (and
dedicated) of-the-community-for-the-community collaboration, and we depend on community
support to achieve our mission.

To donate to Copyleft Cultivars, please email us at
[copyleftcultivars@gmail.com](mailto:copyleftcultivars@gmail.com).

## Volunteer

**Join our community collaboration.**

We need people who write code, people who can check plant and trait data against
published sources, people who translate between English and Spanish, and growers who
keep field notes. We are also seeking genomics experts, lawyers, and nonprofit
professionals.

Small first tasks, each sized for an evening, are listed as "good first issue" on
[Cultivars MCP on GitHub](https://github.com/CopyleftCultivars/cultivars-mcp/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3A%22good+first+issue%22).
Each one says which file to change, how to test it, and what done looks like.

For anything else, email us at
[copyleftcultivars@gmail.com](mailto:copyleftcultivars@gmail.com) and tell us how you'd
like to help.
